'''Moon Jeong Park''' (박문정) is a [[Koreans|Korean]] [[chemical engineer]] who is a Professor of Chemistry at [[Pohang University of Science and Technology]]. She is interested in polymers for energy storage and transport. She studies the transport in charge-containing polymeric materials.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-10-16|title='인공 근육' 박사 박문정 포항공대 교수의 최근 연구는…|url=http://weekly.chosun.com/client/news/viw.asp?ctcd=C08&nNewsNumb=002629100027|access-date=2021-03-14|website=weekly.chosun.com|language=ko}}</ref> She is the second non-American recipient to be awarded the [[American Physical Society]] [[John H. Dillon Medal|John D. Dillion Medal]] and the 2016 [[Hanwha Total]] [[IUPAC]] Young Scientist Award.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Prize Recipient|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/prizes/prizerecipient.cfm?first_nm=Moon&last_nm=Park&year=2017|access-date=2021-03-14|website=www.aps.org|language=en}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite journal|date=2016-12-01|title=Hanwha Total IUPAC Young Scientist Award 2016|journal=Chemistry International|language=de|volume=38|issue=6|pages=19–20|doi=10.1515/ci-2016-0613|issn=1365-2192|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|title=포스텍 박문정 교수, 미국물리학회 '딜런 메달'|url=https://www.chosun.com/site/data/html_dir/2017/01/27/2017012700046.html|access-date=2021-03-14|website=[[The Chosun Ilbo]]|date=22 July 2020 |language=ko}}</ref>

== Early Career and education ==
Park was born in 1977 in [[South Korea]].<ref name=":1" /> Park completed her Ph.D. the [[Seoul National University]] in 2006. She was advised by [[Kookheon Char]].<ref name=":0" /> In 2009, she was a postdoctoral research fellow with [[Nitash P. Balsara]] at [[University of California, Berkeley]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cchem.berkeley.edu/npbgrp/people_alumni.html|access-date=2021-03-14|website=www.cchem.berkeley.edu}}</ref>

== Research and career ==
Park joined as assistant professor to the department of chemistry at Pohang University of Science and Technology in 2009.<ref name=":0" /> She was promoted to associate professor in 2013. Her research interests includes understanding the thermodynamics and transport in charge-containing polymeric materials.<ref>{{Cite web|title='수소 자동차' 연료전지 필수 원천기술 개발|url=http://news.imaeil.com/NewestAll/2010100610235939719|access-date=2021-03-14|website=news.imaeil.com|date=6 October 2010 }}</ref> Park specifically focuses on developing polymeric materials that are more efficient, predictable, and sustainable for energy storage and transport.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|date=2013-07-12|title=국내 연구진, 고성능 구리이온 검출센서 개발|url=https://www.hankyung.com/society/article/201307123145g|access-date=2021-03-14|website=[[The Korea Economic Daily]]|language=ko}}</ref>  She has developed a lithium sulfur battery technology to increased charging speeds and have longer battery life.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2015-12-21|title=미래부, 2015년 우수과학자포상 통합 시상식 개최|url=https://www.edaily.co.kr/news/read?newsId=03043846609600816&mediaCodeNo=257|access-date=2021-03-14|website=이데일리|language=ko}}</ref> Her main contributions have been in ionic-liquid containing polymers, design of self-assembled polymer electrolytes, organic-organics nano-hybrids for enhanced ion/charge transport, and chemical sensors based on ionic polymers.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|date=2016-06-28|title=Hanwha-Total IUPAC Young Scientist Award 2016|url=https://iupac.org/hanwha-total-iupac-young-scientist-award-2016/|access-date=2021-03-14|website=IUPAC {{!}} International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry|language=en-US}}</ref> She also works on electric responsive actuators to create artificial muscles.<ref>{{Cite web|last=www.etnews.com|date=2013-07-30|title=저전압에서 사람과 같이 움직일 수 있는 액추에이터 개발|url=https://www.etnews.com/201307300293?SNS=00002|access-date=2021-03-14|website=대한민국 IT포털의 중심! 이티뉴스|language=ko}}</ref>

Park is an associate editor of ''[[Macromolecules (journal)|Macromolecules]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Macromolecules|url=https://pubs.acs.org/page/mamobx/editors.html|access-date=2021-03-14|website=pubs.acs.org|language=en}}</ref> She also on the editorial board of ''[[Journal of Polymer Science|Journal of Polymer Science: Polymer Physics]]'' and ''[[Journal of Applied Polymer Science]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Journal of Applied Polymer Science|url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/10974628/homepage/editorialboard.html|access-date=2021-03-14|website=Wiley Online Library|doi=10.1002/(ISSN)1097-4628 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Journal of Polymer Science|url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/26424169/homepage/editorial-board|access-date=2021-03-14|website=Wiley Online Library|doi=10.1002/(ISSN)2642-4169 |language=en}}</ref>

* 2025: [[POSCO TJ Park Prize]], POSCO TJ Park Foundation
* 2024: [[Scientist of the Month]], [[Ministry of Science and ICT]] and [[National Research Foundation of Korea]]
* 2021: [[Fellow of the American Physical Society]], "for creative and insightful experiments to elucidate the roles of molecular architecture and self-assembled nanostructure on the electrical, ion transport, and mechanical properties of charged polymers"<ref>{{cite web|title=Fellows nominated in 2021 by the Division of Polymer Physics|work=APS Fellows archive|publisher=American Physical Society|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=2021&unit_id=DPOLY&institution=|access-date=2021-10-22}}</ref>
* 2017: [[American Physical Society]] [[John H. Dillon Medal|John H. Dillion Medal]]<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-10-16|title='인공 근육' 박사 박문정 포항공대 교수의 최근 연구는…|url=http://weekly.chosun.com/client/news/viw.asp?ctcd=C08&nNewsNumb=002629100027|access-date=2021-03-14|website=weekly.chosun.com|language=ko}}</ref><ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2" />
* 2016: 20th Young Scientist Award, [[Ministry of Science and Technology (South Korea)]]. ICT and Future Planning of Korea
* 2016: [[Hanwha Total]]-[[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry|IUPAC]] Young Polymer Scientist Award<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /><ref name=":3" />
* 2015: [[Woman Scientist/Engineer of the Year Award]]<ref name=":0" />
* 2011: Asia Excellence Award Young Scientists, [[Society of Polymer Science, Japan|Society of Polymer Science Japan]]<ref name=":1" />
* 2011: Chong-Am Science Fellowship, [[POSCO]] (formerly Pohang Iron and Steel Company), TJ Park Foundation<ref name=":1" />
* 2004: Best Paper Award, IUPAC World Polymer Congress<ref name=":1" />
